categories.name: Windows
categories.description: Aluminium window systems combining elegance with superior thermal, acoustic, and water insulation.

products.name: FY 65 Casement Window
products.tagline: Outward opening window with slim sightlines
products.description: The FY 65 series offers exceptional thermal and acoustic performance with a sleek aluminium profile. Ideal for residential and commercial applications requiring superior insulation.

products.name: FY 65 Tilt & Turn Window
products.tagline: Dual-action window for ventilation and easy cleaning
products.description: The FY 65 Tilt & Turn offers two opening modes — tilt inward from the top for ventilation, or turn inward like a door for full opening. Perfect for high-rise buildings and hard-to-reach locations.

products.name: FY 55 Fixed Window
products.tagline: Non-opening window for maximum light and views
products.description: The FY 55 fixed window provides maximum glass area with minimal frame visibility, designed for panoramic views and flood of natural light.
features: Can be combined with operable windows

products.name: Aluminium Louver Window
products.description: Aluminium louver windows provide controlled ventilation while preventing rain ingress. Ideal for utility areas, stairwells, and spaces requiring constant airflow.
features: Available in fixed and operable versions

categories.name: Doors
categories.description: Aluminium door systems including entrance, pivot, and folding doors for every application.

products.name: FY 65 Casement Door
products.tagline: Classic swing door with superior insulation
products.description: The FY 65 casement door combines elegant design with outstanding thermal and acoustic performance. Available in single or double leaf configurations for residential and commercial entrances.

products.name: Pivot Door System
products.description: Create a grand entrance with our pivot door system. The center-pivot mechanism allows for oversized doors that make a bold architectural statement while maintaining smooth operation.

products.name: Sliding & Folding Door
products.tagline: Maximum opening for seamless indoor-outdoor living
products.description: The sliding & folding door system folds away neatly to one side, creating an unobstructed opening that seamlessly connects indoor and outdoor spaces.
features: Folds flat to one or both sides

categories.name: Sliding Systems
categories.description: Space-saving sliding solutions for residential and commercial applications.

products.name: GY 55 Sliding Window
products.tagline: Smooth gliding window for space efficiency
products.description: The GY 55 sliding window system offers effortless operation with smooth-running rollers. Ideal where swing-out clearance is limited, providing excellent ventilation and views.

products.name: GY 175 Lift & Slide Door
products.description: The GY 175 lift & slide system handles large, heavy panels with ease. The lift mechanism raises the panel off its seals for smooth sliding, then drops it back down for an airtight seal.
features: Slim interlock for maximum glass area

categories.name: Facades & Curtain Walls
categories.description: Structural glazing and curtain wall systems for commercial and high-rise applications.

products.name: Stick Curtain Wall System
products.tagline: Versatile facade system for any building envelope
products.description: The MX stick curtain wall system is assembled on-site from aluminium mullions and transoms, creating a continuous building envelope. Suitable for both new construction and renovation projects.

products.name: Structural Glazing System
products.tagline: Seamless glass facade with hidden framing
products.description: Structural glazing creates a smooth, uninterrupted glass surface on the building exterior by bonding glass to the aluminium frame with structural silicone, hiding all framing from view.

categories.name: Balustrades & Railings
categories.description: Glass and aluminium railing systems for balconies, terraces, and staircases.

products.name: Frameless Glass Railing
products.description: Frameless glass railings provide safety without compromising views. The aluminium base channel securely holds toughened or laminated glass panels for balconies, terraces, and pool areas.
features: Suitable for indoor and outdoor use

products.name: Post & Glass Railing
products.tagline: Elegant post system with glass infill panels
products.description: The post and glass railing system combines aluminium posts with glass infill panels, offering a versatile solution for staircases, balconies, and mezzanines.

categories.name: Handles & Hardware
categories.description: Exclusive collection of handles, locks, and hardware accessories for aluminium systems.

products.name: Premium Handle Collection
products.tagline: Refined aesthetics for every window and door
products.description: Our premium handle collection features ergonomically designed handles available in a range of finishes to complement any interior style. Compatible with all Technal window and door systems.

products.name: Multi-Point Locking System
products.tagline: Enhanced security with multiple locking points
products.description: Multi-point locking systems engage at multiple points along the door or window frame, providing superior security and weather sealing compared to single-point locks.
